title: 50 going on 51? Madras High Court clarifies age till which woman is eligible for surrogacy
description: The Madras High Court recently held that women are eligible to opt for surrogacy through their 50th year until they turn 51 years of age, which is the upper age limit prescribed for intending mothers under the Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021 [Nandhini Devi Vs State of Tamil Nadu].Justice Shamim Ahmed said the expression “between 23 to 50 years” under Section 4(iii)(c)(I) (age limits of intending parents) of the Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021 must be read to include a woman who has completed 5
